resumeText:
Amit Chauhan | Chandigarh | amit.chauhan.sysadmin@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Information Technology, Sukhna College of Information Technology, Chandigarh (2023 - 2026) | CGPA 7.7/10

INTERNSHIP
IT Support Intern, Shivalik Infotech Services, Mohali (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025, 10 weeks)
- Closed 60+ helpdesk tickets in Freshservice for laptop, email and printer requests.
- Troubleshot printer and network connectivity issues for 40 office staff.
- Created and disabled user accounts in Active Directory for joiners and leavers.

PROJECTS
- Windows Server lab (academic, Network Administration course): Installed Windows Server 2019 as a domain controller and applied group policy for password rules as part of the Network Administration course.
- Home lab (personal): Ran Ubuntu and CentOS virtual machines on Hyper-V and set up an Apache web server on Linux.
- Campus network design (academic, Computer Networks course): Designed VLANs and subnets for a three-floor building in Cisco Packet Tracer as part of the Computer Networks course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- CompTIA A+ (2025); Red Hat System Administration I course (online)
- Coursework: Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Network Administration, Information Security

SKILLS
Linux, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V, PowerShell basics, TCP/IP, Freshservice

ACTIVITIES
- Lab assistant volunteer, college computer centre
- NCC cadet
